title: BetSlip Doctor
description: Read, grade, and track a subscriber's betslips with preserved truth and no wager placement.
summary: Read, grade, and track a subscriber's betslips with preserved truth and no wager placement.
offersHint: Read, grade, and track a subscriber's betslips with preserved truth and no wager placement. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.betslipdoctor.ai/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_tracked_slips
toolsPreview.description: Read the authenticated user's tracked ticket trees and tracking lifecycle. Provider placement ids and sportsbook deep links are never returned.

toolsPreview.name: track_slip
toolsPreview.description: Create or revise one of the authenticated user's ticket trees. This stores truth state only; it never places, prepares, or hands off a wager.

toolsPreview.name: get_todays_board
toolsPreview.description: Live sports board: upcoming and in-play games with main-market prices (moneyline, spread, total) and the best posted price per selection across connected books. Read-only decision support; never a guarantee and never a wager.

toolsPreview.name: grade_slip
toolsPreview.description: Submit betslip text and get BetSlip Doctor's graded second opinion: rank, score, per-leg calls, ten-dimension checkup and sourced evidence. Entertainment/decision support only. Uses the user's plan allowance exactly like grading in the app.

toolsPreview.name: get_saved_reports
toolsPreview.description: List the authenticated user's saved diagnosis reports (newest first), or fetch one full report by id. Only ever the calling user's own reports.

toolsPreview.name: get_history_summary
toolsPreview.description: The authenticated user's imported betting-history ledger: W-L record, stake and net over lifetime/30d/7d windows, sync freshness, and their most recent bets. Numbers come only from the user's own imported slips; nothing is fabricated.

toolsPreview.name: price_shop_slip
toolsPreview.description: Compare posted prices across books for each leg of a slip (main markets). Reports every book's quote, the best price for the bettor, and how much the user's own line gives up. Only ever describes books with real posted data; read-only, never places a wager.
